value.rationale: This is the full naturally-defined collision and adjacency classification of a motivated finite degree-four algebraic map, including two geometrically different branch singular loci, a cubic-tangency intersection curve, a transverse collision curve and the unique maximally nonreduced fibre. These geometric data are not specified by the earlier decomposition into normalized branch components or S4 monodromy, and they distinguish triple-root and double-double degenerations across the map. The classification is not a claim about BS ideals or a trivial special-parameter substitution.
